name: Mage’s Manacle

summary: Once a day after it binds someone: chain a Grappled or Incapacitated creature (Dex DC 15) for 8 hours.
text: As a Magic action while wearing this manacle you can target a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet that has the Grappled or Incapacitated condition. It makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or has the Restrained condition, chained to you, for 8 hours or until you let it go (no action). Only Disintegrate can destroy the chain. Once it has bound a creature it can't do so again until the next dawn.

powers.name: Chain
powers.text: Chain a Grappled or Incapacitated creature within 5 ft (Dex DC 15).
